[**Here’s a video professor recorded**](https://www.loom.com/share/3228d91e431e4be4b3f1c871df7f1db3?sid=0f022c43-6667-447e-b63c-7be544e9643b) in a previous semester walking through how to navigate this article to answer some similar questions I’m asking this semester. ### Discussion Questions.

1.  **Review the Meyer et al. (2001) article on effect sizes.** Identify a relationship from Table 1 or Table 2 that you think is interesting / have heard about in other classes. Write this relationship out as a model.

2.  **REPLY TO ANOTHER PERSON :** Apply the “four reasons” framework to evaluate why their relationship might occur. Yay.
